actions.description: Click once: the bird jumps (velocity set to -4.6 px/frame, rising about 40 px over the next 0.3 s before falling again). On the splash screen this starts the game.
Do nothing this tick. Gravity keeps pulling the bird down (+0.25 px/frame each frame).

notes: Pick flap or wait every 96 ms. If over is true: wait. If playing is false and over is false (splash screen): flap to start. Otherwise compare two numbers. marginIfFlap and marginIfWait are the best worst-case clearance in px that the bird can still keep over the next ~0.8 s if it flaps now or holds off this tick, with later flaps timed as well as possible. Clearance is measured to the gap edges while inside a pipe, to the ground, and to a band that widens with distance around the upcoming gaps. It is capped at 190 and slightly favours near-term safety. A value below -200 (crashIfFlap / crashIfWait true) means a crash can't be avoided; less negative means the crash comes later. Rule: flap only when marginIfFlap > marginIfWait; if they are equal, wait. The other fields are context. roomAbove/roomBelow are the px between the bird's hitbox and the next gap's top and bottom edges. pipeDx/msToPipe are the distance and time until the bird's front enters that pipe (inPipe is true while inside it). msToClear is the time until it is past the pipe. vel is px per 60 Hz frame (+ is down). roomToGround is the px left above the ground. nextGapShift is how much lower (+) or higher (-) the following gap is. passed is the number of pipes cleared. unknownThing is an unrecognised object ahead; treat it as an obstacle.
